q1_issues.issue: The copula is reified as a `be` event (with statement 4 attaching the entrance as its Experiencer), but a copular clause reifies no eventuality in the instruction set and no `be` event class is licensed anywhere — a thing's position is an entity-level static predication.

The clause's whole content — where the entrance is — is carried by an event oblique Location, which the instruction set explicitly forbids for the position of a THING ("never Location on an entity"; the head is the event-vs-entity distinction).

q2_gaps: static NON-containment spatial relation between two entities ("around the corner", "next to the bakery", "across from the station", "behind the shed") — LocatedIn is defined for containment and Location requires an event, so a copular locative with a relative-position preposition has no licensed form
notes: (PartOf sk_entrance_1 sk_station_1) is a fair component reading of "the entrance to the station" and is licensed by the words, though an entity-attached "to"-PP is covered only indirectly (the instruction set names "of" genitives and "from" origins). Both definites are correctly witnessed and typed.
